geronimoleysen: Otto Geronimoleys came from Varenne, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

A letter reached Otto Geronimoleys from Varenne. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Otto Geronimoleys read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Otto Geronimoleys taught Hugo Luissantos to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home reached Otto Geronimoleys before dusk. Otto Geronimoleys read it twice and slept a little easier.
major_detroit313: Viktor Detroit arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a tin of tobacco and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
The first hundred were recognised, and Viktor Detroit was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.

The blanket exchange left Viktor Detroit with a better blanket and a reputation for sharp dealing. The previous owner wants a rematch. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Viktor Detroit could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Viktor Detroit put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
Viktor Detroit spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.

There is a sniper across the way the men call the Clockmaker. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Clockmaker hit all three. Viktor Detroit watched where the shots came from. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Viktor Detroit looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Viktor Detroit lay in the ruins of Sorrow Copse all day. the Clockmaker did not fire once. Neither did Viktor Detroit. Both of them know.
